scripts.postinstall: (prisma generate || echo "prisma generate failed - CI-uploaded client will be used in production, this only matters for local dev") && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');const files=['scripts/ensureAccountsNodeModulesLink.js','scripts/ensureAttendanceNodeModulesLink.js','scripts/ensurePdfGeneratorNodeModulesLink.js','scripts/ensureMoneyReceiptGeneratorNodeModulesLink.js'];for(const file of files){if(fs.existsSync(file)){const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[file],{stdio:'inherit'});if(result.status)process.exit(result.status);}}"
